An '''electronic key''' was a form of security identification. Governments allied with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] employed security measures such as electronic keys and coded [[Identichip/Legends|identification cards]], which functioned in a similar manner to [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]].<ref name="EGWT" />
